rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when making a value, quality, level, intensity, or degree higher.

example.english: We need to elevate the quality of our service to retain customers.
example.traditional: 我哋要提高服務質素，先至留得住客人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 gou1 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3 sin1 zi3 lau4 dak1 zyu6 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for physically lifting something to a higher position, such as raising someone's legs.

example.english: Please help elevate my legs; they will be less swollen that way.
example.traditional: 你幫我抬高啲隻腳啦，咁樣冇咁腫。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 toi4 gou1 di1 zek3 goek3 laa1 gam3 joeng2 mou5 gam3 zung2

rows.note: Use this for advancing a person to a higher rank or position in an organisation.

example.english: The boss finally decided to elevate him to department head.
example.traditional: 老闆終於決定提拔佢做部門主管。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 tai4 bat6 keoi5 zou6 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2
